MY ASSUMPTION: share below HILs 0.70 (the 86 RGI and shelter-rate homes over 123), the setbacks (the tool's placeholders 3.7/6.0/3.0 m), floor to floor 3.3 m, the Community Housing Fund as the program tested (the release names it), trees left blank.
